items.meaning: DHCP provides a mechanism for transmitting configuration parameters to hosts using the TCP/IP protocol suite.
The format of DHCP messages is based on the format of BOOTP messages.
DHCP and BOOTP participants may exchange messages in certain circumstances.
This document specifies the ways in which DHCP and BOOTP participants may interoperate.
The format of DHCP messages is defined to be compatible with the format of BOOTP messages.
Any message received by a DHCP server that includes a 'DHCP message type' (51) option is assumed to have been sent by a DHCP client.
Messages without the DHCP Message Type option are assumed to have been sent by a BOOTP client.
Support of BOOTP clients by a DHCP server is optional at the discretion of the local system administrator.
If a DHCP server that is not configured to support BOOTP clients receives a BOOTREQUEST message from a BOOTP client, that server silently discards the BOOTREQUEST message.
If a DHCP server is configured to support BOOTP clients, it may be configured to supply static addresses, automatic addresses or both.
items.constraint: may be configured to supply static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.object: static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.condition: If a DHCP server is configured to support BOOTP clients

items.meaning: Static addresses are those previously assigned by a system administrator and stored in a database available to the DHCP server.
Automatic addresses are those selected by the DHCP server from its pool of unassigned addresses.
The decision to allow a DHCP server to return automatic addresses must be under the control of the system administrator.
items.constraint: the decision to allow a DHCP server to return automatic addresses must be under the control of the system administrator

items.meaning: If a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients, this feature must be configurable.
items.constraint: this feature must be configurable
items.condition: If a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: If a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients, the feature must default off.
items.constraint: the feature must default off
items.condition: If a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: Enabling of the feature must be the result of an active decision by the system administrator.
items.constraint: Enabling of the feature must be the result of an active decision by the system administrator
items.action: be the result of an active decision by

items.meaning: If a DHCP server returns a automatic address, the BOOTP client will not be aware of the DHCP lease mechanism for network address assignment.
The DHCP server must assign an infinite lease duration to for automatic addresses assigned to BOOTP clients.
items.constraint: the DHCP server must assign an infinite lease duration to for automatic addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.object: an infinite lease duration to for automatic addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.condition: If a DHCP server returns a automatic address

items.meaning: Such network addresses cannot be automatically reassigned by the server.
items.constraint: Such network addresses cannot be automatically reassigned by the server

items.meaning: The local system administrator may choose to manually release network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients.
items.constraint: may choose to manually release network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.object: network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器必须依照 BOOTP 协议与 BOOTP 客户端交互。
items.constraint: 支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器 MUST 按 BOOTP 协议与 BOOTP 客户端交互
items.condition: that supports BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 服务器必须构造 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 消息而不是 DHCP DHCPOFFER 消息。
items.constraint: 服务器 MUST 构造 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 消息而非 DHCP DHCPOFFER 消息
items.object: BOOTP BOOTREPLY message rather than a DHCP DHCPOFFER message

items.meaning: 服务器不得在 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 中包含 DHCP 消息类型选项。
items.constraint: 服务器 MUST NOT 包含 'DHCP message type' 选项

items.meaning: 服务器不得超出 BOOTREPLY 消息的大小限制。
items.constraint: 服务器 MUST NOT 超出 BOOTREPLY 消息的大小限制
items.object: the size limit for BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: 服务器在发送 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 后把 BOOTP 客户端的绑定标记为 BOUND。
DHCP 服务器可以按 DHCP 选项与 BOOTP 厂商扩展 RFC 所允许的范围向 BOOTP 客户端发送任意 DHCP 选项。
items.object: any DHCP Options to a BOOTP client
items.condition: as allowed by the "DHCP Options and BOOTP Vendor Extensions" RFC [2]

items.meaning: 服务器可以向 BOOTP 客户端返回自动分配的地址。
若向 BOOTP 客户端返回自动分配的地址，则必须提供配置开关。
items.constraint: 若向 BOOTP 客户端返回自动地址，MUST 提供配置开关
items.condition: if returning automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 该可选配置必须默认为 OFF。
items.constraint: MUST 将该可选配置默认设为 OFF

items.meaning: BOOTP 规范：与 BOOTP 客户端交互时必须遵守的规范
items.constraint: MUST abide by the BOOTP specification when interacting with BOOTP clients
items.condition: when interacting with BOOTP clients

items.meaning: DHCP 选项文档中定义但 BOOTP 厂商扩展文档中未定义的选项，可以发送给 BOOTP 客户端
items.constraint: MAY send DHCP options (those options defined in the DHCP options document but not in the BOOTP vendor extensions documents) to a BOOTP client
items.object: DHCP options to a BOOTP client

items.meaning: DHCP 客户端：当 BOOTP 服务器返回的配置可接受时可以使用该应答
items.constraint: A DHCP client MAY use a reply from a BOOTP server if the configuration returned from the BOOTP server is acceptable to the DHCP client
items.object: a reply from a BOOTP server
items.condition: if the configuration returned from the BOOTP server is acceptable to the DHCP client

items.meaning: DHCP 客户端：必须假定 BOOTP 服务器消息中返回的 IP 地址具有无限租期
items.constraint: A DHCP client MUST assume that an IP address returned in a message from a BOOTP server has an infinite lease
items.object: that an IP address returned in a message from a BOOTP server has an infinite lease

items.meaning: DHCP 服务器：DHCP 客户端应优先选择 DHCP 服务器的应答而非 BOOTP 服务器的应答
items.constraint: A DHCP client SHOULD choose to use a reply from a DHCP server in preference to a reply from a BOOTP server
items.object: a reply from a DHCP server in preference to a reply from a BOOTP server

items.meaning: 原始 BOOTP 规范；文档称其遗留了若干未明确的问题，如中继代理的确切行为未被清楚规定
本文档：除本文档或后续文档另有规定外，本文档通篇所述的信息与要求同样适用于 BOOTP 的扩展（如 DHCP）
该词或形容词 REQUIRED 表示该项是规范的绝对要求。
该词或形容词 RECOMMENDED 表示在特定情形下可能有正当理由忽略该项，但在选择不同做法前应理解全部影响并仔细权衡。
该短语表示在特定情形下所列行为可能可接受甚至有用，但在实现该标签描述的任何行为前应理解全部影响并仔细权衡。
该词或形容词 OPTIONAL 表示该项真正可选，一个厂商可选择包含而另一个厂商可省略同一项。
备忘录规定若干情形下 BOOTP 实体要静默丢弃收到的 BOOTP 消息。
静默丢弃表示实体丢弃消息而不进一步处理，并且不会因此发送任何 ICMP 错误消息。
为诊断问题，实体 SHOULD 提供记录错误的能力，包括静默丢弃消息的内容。
items.constraint: SHOULD provide the capability of logging the error, including the contents of the silently-discarded message
items.object: the capability of logging the error, including the contents of the silently-discarded message
items.condition: for diagnosis of problems

items.meaning: 为诊断问题，SHOULD 将该事件记录在统计计数器中。
items.constraint: SHOULD record the event in a statistics counter
items.object: the event in a statistics counter
items.condition: for diagnosis of problems

items.meaning: Whenever a multi-octet field represents a numeric quantity, the leftmost bit of the whole field is the most significant bit.
The following consistency checks SHOULD be performed on BOOTP messages.
items.constraint: The following consistency checks SHOULD be performed on BOOTP messages.

items.entity: IP Total Length and UDP Length
items.meaning: The IP Total Length and UDP Length must be large enough to contain the minimal BOOTP header of 300 octets in the UDP data field specified in [1].
items.constraint: The IP Total Length and UDP Length must be large enough to contain the minimal BOOTP header of 300 octets (in the UDP data field) specified in [1].

items.meaning: Future extensions to the BOOTP protocol may increase the size of BOOTP messages.
BOOTP messages that are larger than the minimum size specified by [1], according to the IP Total Length and UDP Length fields, MUST also be accepted.
items.constraint: BOOTP messages which, according to the IP Total Length and UDP Length fields, are larger than the minimum size specified by [1] MUST also be accepted.
items.object: BOOTP messages larger than the minimum size
items.condition: which, according to the IP Total Length and UDP Length fields, are larger than the minimum size specified by [1]

items.meaning: The 'op' (opcode) field of the message must contain either the code for a BOOTREQUEST (1) or the code for a BOOTREPLY (2).
items.constraint: The 'op' (opcode) field of the message must contain either the code for a BOOTREQUEST (1) or the code for a BOOTREPLY (2).
items.object: either the code for a BOOTREQUEST (1) or the code for a BOOTREPLY (2)

items.meaning: 未通过这些一致性检查的 BOOTP 消息必须被静默丢弃。
items.constraint: BOOTP messages not meeting these consistency checks MUST be silently discarded.
items.condition: not meeting these consistency checks

items.meaning: 客户端必须将 'flags' 字段的其余比特置零。
items.constraint: They MUST be set to zero by clients and ignored by servers

items.meaning: 服务器必须忽略 'flags' 字段的其余比特。
items.constraint: They MUST be set to zero by clients and ignored by servers

items.meaning: MBZ 保留供未来使用，并且必须为零。
items.constraint: MBZ MUST BE ZERO (reserved for future use)

items.meaning: 'chaddr' 字段中链路级硬件地址所用的位序应当与客户端链路级网络上 ARP 协议所用的位序相同。
items.constraint: The bit ordering used for link-level hardware addresses in the 'chaddr' field SHOULD be the same as the ordering used for the ARP protocol [4] on the client's link-level network (assuming ARP is defined for that network).
items.object: ordering used for the ARP protocol on the client's link-level network
items.condition: assuming ARP is defined for that network

items.meaning: 'chaddr' 字段必须按 BOOTP 客户端指定的内容原样保留。
items.constraint: The 'chaddr' field MUST be preserved as it was specified by the BOOTP client.

items.meaning: 中继代理不得反转 'chaddr' 字段的位序，即使它恰好在两个使用不同位序的网络之间中继 BOOTREQUEST。
items.constraint: A relay agent MUST NOT reverse the bit ordering of the 'chaddr' field even if it happens to be relaying a BOOTREQUEST between two networks which use different bit orderings.
items.condition: even if it happens to be relaying a BOOTREQUEST between two networks which use different bit orderings

items.meaning: The contents of the 'chaddr' field are often used to create an ARP-cache entry in the same way the normal ARP protocol would have.
Interoperability can only be achieved if a consistent interpretation of the 'chaddr' field is used.
items.constraint: consistent interpretation of the 'chaddr' field

items.meaning: Special consideration of client/server and client/relay agent interactions must be given to IEEE 802.5 networks because of non-transparent bridging.
items.constraint: Special consideration of client/server and client/relay agent interactions for IEEE 802.5 networks
items.object: client/server and client/relay agent interactions for IEEE 802.5 networks

items.meaning: The client SHOULD send its broadcast BOOTREQUEST with an All Routes Explorer RIF.
items.constraint: client SHOULD send its broadcast BOOTREQUEST with an All Routes Explorer RIF
items.object: its broadcast BOOTREQUEST with an All Routes Explorer RIF

items.meaning: For server/relay agents that cannot cache the return route, the BOOTREPLY message SHOULD be sent to the client's hardware address, as taken from the BOOTP message, with a Spanning Tree Rooted RIF.
items.constraint: BOOTREPLY message SHOULD be sent to the client's hardware address with a Spanning Tree Rooted RIF when return route cannot be cached
items.object: the BOOTREPLY message to the client's hardware address, as taken from the BOOTP message, with a Spanning Tree Rooted RIF
items.condition: For those server/relay agents which cannot cache the return route (because they are stateless, for example)

items.meaning: In the former case, the Routing Information Field (RIF) will not be used.
In the latter case, the RIF field will be used, resulting in a few extraneous bytes on the ring.
If the server/relay agent is on another segment of the ring, the client cannot reach it when the RIF is not used.
If a client falls into this category, it SHOULD set to 1 the BROADCAST flag in the 'flags' field of BOOTREPLY messages it generates.
items.constraint: client SHOULD set (to 1) the BROADCAST flag in the 'flags' field of BOOTREPLY messages it generates
items.object: the BROADCAST flag in the 'flags' field of BOOTREPLY messages it generates
items.condition: If a client falls into this category

items.meaning: The BROADCAST flag provides a hint to BOOTP servers and relay agents that they should attempt to broadcast their BOOTREPLY messages to the client.
items.constraint: BOOTP servers and relay agents should attempt to broadcast their BOOTREPLY messages to the client
items.object: their BOOTREPLY messages to the client

items.constraint: SHOULD NOT set the BROADCAST flag; SHOULD clear the BROADCAST flag to 0
items.condition: If a client does not have this limitation (i.e., it is perfectly able to receive unicast BOOTREPLY messages)

items.meaning: 旧的（主机）实现 SHOULD 被修改，使其能够接收单播 BOOTREPLY 消息。
items.constraint: Such implementations SHOULD be modified so that they may receive unicast BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: 客户端在它生成的所有 BOOTREQUEST 消息中必须将这些保留位（flags 字段的剩余位）置零。
items.constraint: A client MUST set these bits to zero in all BOOTREQUEST messages it generates
items.object: these bits (remaining bits of the 'flags' field) in all BOOTREQUEST messages it generates

items.meaning: 客户端在所有 BOOTREPLY 消息中必须忽略这些保留位。
items.constraint: A client MUST ignore these bits in all BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: BOOTREQUEST 消息的 'secs' 字段 SHOULD 表示自客户端发送其第一个 BOOTREQUEST 消息以来经过的秒数。

items.object: the elapsed time, in seconds, since the client sent its first BOOTREQUEST message

items.constraint: the 'secs' field of the first BOOTREQUEST message SHOULD be set to zero
items.object: the 'secs' field of the first BOOTREQUEST message

items.meaning: 客户端不应把 'secs' 字段设置为对所有 BOOTREQUEST 消息都取同一个常量的值。
items.constraint: Clients SHOULD NOT set the 'secs' field to a value which is constant for all BOOTREQUEST messages

items.meaning: 'secs' 字段的原始定义含糊，未明确其表示的是首个 BOOTREQUEST 发出后的时间还是其他时间段
对 'secs' 字段做错误实现（置为常量或使用错误字节序）的实现应当被纠正
items.constraint: These incorrect implementations SHOULD be corrected.

items.constraint: the client SHOULD set the 'ciaddr' field to 0.0.0.0

items.constraint: the client MUST be prepared to accept incoming unicast datagrams addressed to that IP address and also answer ARP requests for that IP address
items.action: be prepared to accept incoming unicast datagrams addressed to that IP address and also answer ARP requests for that IP address

items.meaning: 'ciaddr' 字段的用途存在多种不同解释且未达成一致
把 'ciaddr' 用于表达从未使用或当前未使用的期望地址的解释是错误的，可能使 BOOTREPLY 无法到达客户端；服务器通常将回复单播到 'ciaddr' 给出的地址
BOOTREQUEST 消息中的网关地址字段，客户端必须将其置为零
items.constraint: BOOTP client MUST set the 'giaddr' field to zero (0.0.0.0) in all BOOTREQUEST messages it generates.

Vendor Information Extensions 的子字段，客户端可从中获得用于到达非本地服务器的第一跳路由器地址。

items.condition: If a special vendor-specific magic cookie is not being used

items.condition: When the BOOTP relay agent receives a BOOTREQUEST message

items.meaning: 若实现了此类策略机制，其阈值应可配置。
items.constraint: 策略机制的阈值应可配置
items.condition: If such a policy mechanism is implemented

items.meaning: 中继代理必须静默丢弃 'hops' 字段超过 16 的 BOOTREQUEST 消息。
items.constraint: hops > 16 的 BOOTREQUEST 必须被静默丢弃
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages whose 'hops' field exceeds the value 16
items.condition: whose 'hops' field exceeds the value 16

items.meaning: 应提供一个配置选项，以便网络管理员可将该阈值设置为更小的值。
items.constraint: 应提供配置选项以设置更小阈值
items.object: a configuration option to set this threshold to a smaller value
items.condition: if desired by the network manager

items.meaning: 可配置阈值的默认设置应为 4。
items.constraint: 可配置阈值的默认值应为 4

items.meaning: 如果中继代理决定中继请求，它必须检查 'giaddr' 字段。
items.constraint: 决定中继请求时必须检查 giaddr
items.condition: If the relay agent does decide to relay the request

items.meaning: 如果 'giaddr' 字段为零，中继代理必须用接收请求接口的 IP 地址填充该字段。
items.constraint: giaddr 为零时必须以接收接口 IP 填充
items.object: this field with the IP address of the interface on which the request was received
items.condition: If this field is zero

items.meaning: 如果接口有多个逻辑关联的 IP 地址，中继代理应选择一个与该接口关联的 IP 地址，并对其转发的所有 BOOTP 消息一致使用。
items.constraint: 多 IP 接口应选择一个地址并一致使用
items.action: choose one IP address associated with that interface and use it consistently
items.object: one IP address associated with that interface for all BOOTP messages it relays
items.condition: If the interface has more than one IP address logically associated with it

items.meaning: 如果 'giaddr' 字段包含非零值，则该 'giaddr' 字段不得被修改。
items.constraint: giaddr 非零时不得修改
items.condition: If the 'giaddr' field contains some non-zero value

items.meaning: 中继代理在任何情况下都不得用广播地址填充 'giaddr' 字段。
items.constraint: 不得用广播地址填充 giaddr
items.object: the 'giaddr' field with a broadcast address

items.meaning: 'hops' 字段的值必须被递增。
items.constraint: hops 值必须递增

items.meaning: 所有其他 BOOTP 字段必须被完整保留。
items.constraint: 其他 BOOTP 字段必须完整保留

items.meaning: 被中继请求的新目的地必须是可配置的。
items.constraint: This destination MUST be configurable.

items.meaning: 该目的地配置应当独立于任何其他所谓广播转发器的目的地配置。
items.constraint: This destination configuration SHOULD be independent of the destination configuration for any other so-called "broadcast forwarders".

items.entity: configurable list of destination IP addresses
items.meaning: 可配置的目的地IP地址列表提供了良好的灵活性。
中继代理不得在其收到广播的物理接口上重新广播该BOOTREQUEST。
items.constraint: A relay agent MUST NOT rebroadcast the BOOTREQUEST on the physical interface from whence it came.
items.condition: received as a broadcast

items.meaning: 中继代理对于来自给定客户端的所有BOOTREQUEST消息，必须使用相同的目的地或目的地集合。
items.constraint: A relay agent MUST use the same destination (or set of destinations) for all BOOTREQUEST messages it relays from a given client.
items.condition: for all BOOTREQUEST messages it relays from a given client

items.meaning: 来自给定客户端的所有BOOTREQUEST消息必须被中继到相同的目的地或目的地集合。
items.constraint: All BOOTREQUEST messages from a given client MUST be relayed to the same destination (or set of destinations).
items.condition: from a given client

items.meaning: 中继代理在向下一个目的地转发请求时，可设置 IP Time-To-Live 字段为新建数据报的默认值，或为原 BOOTREQUEST 的 TTL 减至少一
items.constraint: may set the IP Time-To-Live field to either the default value for new datagrams originated by the relay agent, or to the TTL of the original BOOTREQUEST decremented by (at least) one
items.condition: When transmitting the request to its next destination

items.meaning: 作为防止 BOOTREQUEST 环路的额外措施，最好使用原 BOOTREQUEST 中递减后的 TTL
items.constraint: preferable to use the decremented TTL from the original BOOTREQUEST

items.meaning: 若 BOOTREQUEST 带有 UDP 校验和（非零），则必须重新计算校验和
items.constraint: the checksum must be recalculated
items.condition: If the BOOTREQUEST has a UDP checksum (i.e., the UDP checksum is non-zero)

items.meaning: BOOTP 中继代理只把 BOOTREPLY 消息中继给 BOOTP 客户端
items.constraint: relay BOOTREPLY messages only to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 中继代理可以假定其收到的所有 BOOTREPLY 消息都是发往其直连网络上的 BOOTP 客户端的
items.constraint: may assume that all BOOTREPLY messages it receives are intended for BOOTP clients on its directly-connected networks
items.object: all BOOTREPLY messages it receives are intended for BOOTP clients on its directly-connected networks

items.meaning: 中继代理收到 BOOTREPLY 消息时应检查 BOOTP 的 giaddr、yiaddr、chaddr、htype 和 hlen 字段
items.constraint: it should examine the BOOTP 'giaddr', 'yiaddr', 'chaddr', 'htype', and 'hlen' fields
items.condition: When a relay agent receives a BOOTREPLY message

items.meaning: 这些字段应为中继代理提供足够信息以把 BOOTREPLY 消息投递给客户端
items.constraint: These fields should provide adequate information for the relay agent to deliver the BOOTREPLY message to the client
items.object: adequate information for the relay agent to deliver the BOOTREPLY message to the client

items.meaning: 'giaddr' 字段可用于标识必须从哪个逻辑接口发送应答（即与 BOOTP 客户端同网段的主机或路由器接口）。
若 'giaddr' 字段内容与中继代理直连的某个逻辑接口不匹配，则必须静默丢弃该 BOOTREPLY 报文。
items.constraint: If the content of the 'giaddr' field does not match one of the relay agent's directly-connected logical interfaces, the BOOTREPLY messsage MUST be silently discarded.
items.condition: If the content of the 'giaddr' field does not match one of the relay agent's directly-connected logical interfaces

items.meaning: 中继代理应检查新定义的 BROADCAST 标志，更多信息参见第 2.2 节和第 3.1.1 节。
items.constraint: The relay agent SHOULD examine the newly-defined BROADCAST flag

items.meaning: 若 BROADCAST 标志置 1，则应答应以 IP 广播方式发送，使用 255.255.255.255 作为 IP 目的地址、链路层广播地址作为链路层目的地址。
items.constraint: If this flag is set to 1, the reply SHOULD be sent as an IP broadcast
items.condition: If this flag is set to 1

items.meaning: 若 BROADCAST 标志被清除（0），则应答应以 IP 单播方式发送到 'yiaddr' 指定的 IP 地址和 'chaddr' 指定的链路层地址。
items.constraint: If the BROADCAST flag is cleared (0), the reply SHOULD be sent as an IP unicast
items.condition: If the BROADCAST flag is cleared (0)

items.meaning: 若无法进行单播，应答可以以广播方式发送，此时应使用链路层广播地址并以 255.255.255.255 作为 IP 目的地址。
items.constraint: If unicasting is not possible, the reply MAY be sent as a broadcast, in which case it SHOULD be sent to the link-layer broadcast address
items.condition: If unicasting is not possible

items.meaning: 'flags' 字段此前在 [1] 中仅被定义为“未使用”字段，因此旧实现可能意外地设置新的 BROADCAST 标志。
若旧客户端或服务器错误地把 BROADCAST 标志置 1，符合规范的中继代理将向对应客户端产生广播 BOOTREPLY 报文。
这些 BOOTREPLY 报文仍应正确到达客户端，代价是多一次（否则不必要的）广播。
意外设置 BROADCAST 标志的旧客户端或服务器实现应被纠正，以正确遵循这一较新的规范。
items.constraint: Older client or server implementations which accidentally set the BROADCAST flag SHOULD be corrected to properly comply with this newer specification.
items.object: Older client or server implementations which accidentally set the BROADCAST flag
items.condition: Older client or server implementations which accidentally set the BROADCAST flag

items.meaning: 所有 BOOTP 字段必须完整保留。
items.constraint: All BOOTP fields MUST be preserved intact.

items.meaning: 中继代理在向客户端转发时不得修改 BOOTREPLY 报文的任何 BOOTP 字段。
items.constraint: The relay agent MUST NOT modify any BOOTP field of the BOOTREPLY message when relaying it to the client.
items.object: any BOOTP field of the BOOTREPLY message
items.condition: when relaying it to the client

items.meaning: BOOTP 客户端 UDP 端口（68），应答的 UDP 目的端口必须设为该端口
items.constraint: 应答的 UDP 目的端口 MUST 设置为 BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: BOOTP 应答报文；若其 UDP 校验和非零，则发送前必须重新计算校验和
items.constraint: 若 BOOTREPLY 的 UDP 校验和非零，发送前必须重新计算校验和
items.condition: If the BOOTREPLY has a UDP checksum (i.e., the UDP checksum is non-zero)

items.meaning: 主机和路由器通常被要求静默丢弃含非法 IP 源地址的数据报（Martian 地址过滤）
支持 BOOTP 服务器的主机或路由器必须接受 IP 源地址为 0.0.0.0 的 BOOTREQUEST 并本地递交给服务器
items.constraint: 支持 BOOTP 服务器的主机或路由器 MUST 接受源地址 0.0.0.0 的 BOOTREQUEST 用于本地递交
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages whose IP source address is 0.0.0.0 for local delivery to the server
items.condition: hosts or routers which support a BOOTP server

items.meaning: 来自合法 IP 源地址的 BOOTREQUEST 报文也必须被接受
items.constraint: 来自合法 IP 源地址的 BOOTREQUEST MUST 也被接受
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages from legal IP source addresses

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器必须静默丢弃 UDP 目的端口为 BOOTPC (68) 的已接收 UDP 报文
items.constraint: BOOTP 服务器 MUST 静默丢弃目的端口为 BOOTPC (68) 的 UDP 报文
items.object: any received UDP messages whose UDP destination port number is BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器应当无需处理发往 BOOTPC 端口的报文
BOOTP 服务器应执行 Section 2.1 中规定的一致性检查
items.constraint: BOOTP server SHOULD perform consistency checks specified in Section 2.1
items.object: The consistency checks specified in Section 2.1

items.meaning: 不满足这些一致性检查的 BOOTP 消息必须被静默丢弃
items.constraint: BOOTP messages not meeting these consistency checks MUST be silently discarded
items.object: BOOTP messages not meeting these consistency checks
items.condition: not meeting these consistency checks

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器在收到 BOOTREQUEST 时可将 secs 字段值用作决定是否或如何回复的因素
items.constraint: BOOTP server MAY use the value of the 'secs' field as a factor in deciding whether and/or how to reply
items.object: the value of the 'secs' field of the request
items.condition: When the BOOTP server receives a BOOTREQUEST message

items.meaning: 请求中表示客户端开始启动以来的秒数的字段
该协议特性迄今尚未一定被证明有用，讨论见 Section 3.2
BOOTP 服务器应准备好处理对 ciaddr 字段的各种不同解释
items.constraint: A BOOTP server SHOULD be prepared to deal with these varying interpretations

items.meaning: 通常不应把 ciaddr 字段单独作为识别客户端的唯一键
items.constraint: the 'ciaddr' field SHOULD NOT be trusted as a sole key in identifying a client
items.object: the 'ciaddr' field as a sole key in identifying a client

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器应保留 BOOTREPLY 消息中 ciaddr 字段的内容
items.constraint: BOOTP servers SHOULD preserve the contents of the 'ciaddr' field in BOOTREPLY messages
items.object: the contents of the 'ciaddr' field in BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: BOOTREPLY 消息中的 ciaddr 内容应与对应 BOOTREQUEST 消息中的 ciaddr 内容完全一致
items.constraint: the contents of 'ciaddr' in a BOOTREPLY message SHOULD exactly match the contents of 'ciaddr' in the corresponding BOOTREQUEST message
items.object: the contents of 'ciaddr' in the corresponding BOOTREQUEST message

items.meaning: Client may use ciaddr contents to verify a BOOTREPLY was intended for it.

items.constraint: The server SHOULD first check the 'ciaddr' field.

items.constraint: If the 'ciaddr' field is non-zero, the BOOTREPLY message SHOULD be sent as an IP unicast to the IP address identified in the 'ciaddr' field.
items.condition: If the 'ciaddr' field is non-zero

items.constraint: The UDP destination port MUST be set to BOOTPC (68).

items.constraint: The server MUST be aware of the problems identified in Section 3.3.

items.constraint: The server SHOULD next check the 'giaddr' field.

items.constraint: If this field is non-zero, the server SHOULD send the BOOTREPLY as an IP unicast to the IP address identified in the 'giaddr' field.
